name: streamchat
description: A real-time chat overlay for TikTok Live and YouTube Live, packaged as a Tauri desktop app with a local Node.js + Express backend.

scripts.clean: npx rimraf release dist-ts server-dist src-tauri-app/src-tauri/target
scripts.clean:full: npm run clean && npx rimraf src-tauri-app/node_modules src-tauri-app/package-lock.json src-tauri-app/src-tauri/resources/server/node.exe
scripts.dev: cd src-tauri-app && npx kill-port 5000 --silent & npm run tauri dev
scripts.build:all: npm run build:server && npm run build:tauri-resources
scripts.dist:clean: npm run clean && npm run dist
scripts.dist:clean:portable: npm run dist:clean && npm run dist:portable
